title: Powder of Ibn-Ghazi

[[Image:PowderOfIbn-Ghazi.png|right|160px]]
'''Powder of Ibn-Ghazi''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Magical weapon]]

'''Bonus''': +9 [[Combat check]] (Lose 1 [[Sanity]] and discard after use)

'''Hands''': 2

'''Price''': $6

==Mythos Source==

The Powder of Ibn-Ghazi appears in the story ''The Dunwich Horror'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1929).
